basic_info.description: Beautifully remodeled tunnel-entrance home in the Outer Sunset, just a few blocks from N-Judah MUNI, the shops and eateries on Noriega, Judah, and Irving Streets, Golden Gate Park, and Ocean Beach. Popular spots like Andytown Coffee Roasters, Devil's Teeth Baking Company, Hook Fish, Palm City, Polly Ann Ice Cream, and Gus's Community Market are all nearby, offering the ultimate convenience and vibrant lifestyle. The top level features a spacious living room with a fireplace, a formal dining room, a brand-new kitchen with large skylights, a brand-new full bath, and two bedrooms side by side in the back. An interior stairway leads to the ground floor, which includes an unwarranted bedroom and half bath. The large garage offers one-car parking with plenty of extra space for storage or potential expansion. Sitting on a full-sized lot, the home boasts a generous rear yard with mature trees and plants, perfect for gardening or relaxing. Recent upgrades include fresh interior and exterior paint, refinished floors, and new hardwood flooring in the ground-floor room. This move-in-ready home offers modern updates and a prime location near some of the best the Sunset has to offer!
